lines.rookie:
The King's letters copy your mouth.
ㅁ says "m". Say "mmm".
ㄴ says "n". Say "nnn".
ㅇ is the open throat. Say "ah".
ㄱ says "g". ㅅ says "s".
Look at the red line in each picture.
lines.junior:
The King's letters copy the shapes of your mouth.
ㅁ says "m". Try saying "mmm".
ㄴ says "n". Try saying "nnn".
ㅇ is the open throat. Try saying "ah".
ㄱ says "g", and ㅅ says "s".
Look closely at the red line in each picture.
lines.master:
Each of the King's letters is modelled on your mouth.
ㅁ makes the sound "m": say "mmm".
ㄴ makes the sound "n": say "nnn".
ㅇ is the open throat: say "ah".
ㄱ makes "g", and ㅅ makes "s".
Study the red outline in each picture.

lines.master: The tongue's outline turns a corner, as ㄴ does; the throat's outline is round, as ㅇ is.

lines.rookie: The letters copy the mouth!

lines.rookie:
A vowel is a line and a dot.
A standing line with the dot on the RIGHT is ㅏ. It says "a".
With the dot on the LEFT, it is ㅓ. It says "eo".
Each block has a FIRST SOUND, then a VOWEL beside it.
A LAST SOUND sits under them, at the bottom.
Does a block start with a vowel sound? Then ㅇ goes first. It holds the place.
lines.junior:
A vowel is made of a line and a dot.
A standing line with the dot on its RIGHT is ㅏ. It says "a".
With the dot on its LEFT, it is ㅓ. It says "eo".
Every block has a FIRST SOUND, with a VOWEL beside it.
A LAST SOUND, if there is one, sits under them, at the bottom.
If a block starts with a vowel sound, ㅇ goes first to hold the place.
lines.master:
A vowel is built from a line and a dot.
A standing line with its dot on the RIGHT is ㅏ, which says "a".
With the dot on the LEFT, it becomes ㅓ, which says "eo".
Every block begins with a FIRST SOUND, its VOWEL beside it.
A LAST SOUND, when there is one, is written beneath them, at the bottom.
A block that begins with a vowel sound takes ㅇ first, to hold the place.

lines.rookie:
BUN-I'S PRACTICE PAPERS: 어마 · 엄마 · 엄머
Only one is her first word.
SORA'S WORDS, for letters Bun-i has not learned yet: 고마워요 · 미안해요 · 잘 가요
Sora: "Thank you has the block 마."
Sora: "I'm sorry starts with the block 미."
Sora: "Goodbye ends with 가요."
